risks.finding: Broad PUBLIC authenticated RLS policies OR with tenant-scoped policies on customer/order/invoice domains

risks.finding: Legacy SECURITY DEFINER functions are executable by anon/authenticated according to advisor and catalog ACLs

risks.finding: Core command authority binds Primary Auth profile, not actual POS employee or device
risks.impact: offline attribution/revocation cannot be enforced at replay

risks.impact: payment-attested real conflicts cannot be retained/resolved under approved contract

risks.impact: runtime/provider ambiguity can duplicate WhatsApp or notification effects

risks.finding: Payment vocabulary differs across Offline model, route, Core, and invoice constraint

risks.finding: Cancellation function is drifted between Production and repository

risks.finding: invoice reads show disproportionately high sequential scans

risks.finding: best-effort audit is outside business transactions
